info.title: Satflux API
info.description: Initial reviewed scope: account, stores and raffle list/create. Other APIs are explicitly deferred in route-coverage.json. SPA authentication uses the Sanctum session cookie, not a Bearer token. First GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, then send credentials and the decoded XSRF-TOKEN cookie as X-XSRF-TOKEN on writes; CSRF mismatch returns 419. Browser Origin/Referer must match configured stateful domains. Local store UUIDs identify Satflux routes. Ownership, verified-email, guest and entitlement checks remain server-side. Lists here are unpaginated. Nullable max means unlimited, zero means blocked. Counts can be unavailable; do not use counts as authorization.
